dct_description_sm: Abstract: King County, Washington streams. Covers also portions of Snohomish and Pierce Counties.

Purpose: This datalayer contains water courses for King County drainage basins, including some areas in adjoining counties. The streams layer is designed as a topologically complete network of stream centerlines, with extensive related attribute tables.
dct_creator_sm: King County (Wash.). Water and Land Resources Division
dct_rights_sm: Use constraints: For educational non-commercial use only. This data may not be redistributed by HGL users. King County data are made available with the understanding that they shall be used exclusively by the obtainer or his/her authorized agents.
Access constraints: Access is granted to Harvard University Affiliates only. Affiliates are limited to current faculty, staff and students.
Data credit: King County Water & Land Resources, & Washington State Dept. of Ecology
